# About this script
**Purpose:** Organizing the data for the III Simposio Internacional de Ecologia.
**Contact:**[gabriela.dezotti@unesp.br](mailto:gabriela.dezotti@unesp.br)

```{r}
#| label: setup-packages
#| code-summary: "Load packages"
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pkg_list <- c(
  "tidyverse", "tidylog", "readxl", "stringi",
  "magrittr", "clipr", "knitr", "kableExtra",        
  "rgnparser", "flora", "DataEditR", "here"                        
)

# If necessary, install missing packages
 new_packages <- pkg_list[!(pkg_list %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
 if(length(new_packages)) install.packages(new_packages)

invisible(lapply(pkg_list, function(x) 
  library(x, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)))
```


```{r}
#| label: load-rawdata
#| code-summary: "Load raw data"

rawdata = read_csv2(
  here::here("articles_with_ids.csv"),
  na = c("", "NA")
)

glimpse(rawdata)
```

# Data filtering for identification

```{r}
#| label: filter-data
#| code-summary: "Filter data"

selected_articles =
rawdata |>
 select(c(study_id, title, year, journal, doi))

 write.csv(selected_articles, here::here("01_selected_data.csv"))
```

# Organizing data for analysis


```{r}
#| label: organize-data
#| code-summary: "Organize data"

organized_data = 
rawdata |>
  select(c(study_id, species_list, list_location, nomenclatura_source, 
  identification_method, vouchers, notes)) |>
  mutate(
    species_list        = tolower(species_list),
    list_location       = tolower(list_location),
    nomenclatura_source = tolower(nomenclatura_source),
    identification_method = tolower(identification_method),
    vouchers            = tolower(vouchers),
    
    species_list        = factor(species_list),
    list_location       = factor(list_location),
    nomenclatura_source = factor(nomenclatura_source),
    vouchers            = factor(vouchers),
    
    identification_method = factor(
      identification_method,
      levels = c("no", "vague", "explicit"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

glimpse(organized_data)
colSums(is.na(organized_data))
lapply(organized_data, levels)

saveRDS(organized_data, here::here("02_organized_data.rds"))
```
